what_worked: Clear contrarian thesis with a consistent through-line from AI critique to B2B recommendation.
fix_next: Nearly every numeric claim (median AI MRR, category averages, 3.4x LTD multiplier, ARPU table, exit multiples) appears fabricated or unverifiable from the dataset.
verdict: Bold thesis undermined by pervasive fabricated numbers and no sourced charts.
factual_error_detail: Slide 2: AI median stated as $177; reference data shows $503. Slide 2: '24% of all new listings' — AI is 197/726 categorized = 27.1%, but denominator choice unclear and not disclosed. Slide 3: 'Content Workflows $13,800 Avg MRR' — no such category exists in the dataset; Marketing avg is ~$31,364 (mean) not $2,000; AI avg is ~$11,963 not $1,500; categories appear invented. Slide 4: '3.4x' LTD vs subscription multiplier — no pricing-model field exists in the dataset to compute this. Slide 5: ARPU table ($340, $180, $45, $18) and exit multiples (5.2x, 1.8x ARR) are entirely external/fabricated with no dataset grounding. Slide 6: '4.2x MRR multiplier for DR>40' — domain rating is not a field in the provided dataset. Slide 1: '8x more recurring revenue' claim — B2B median multiple from data is ~2.35x, not 8x.

evidence.insight: The core thesis (avoid crowded AI, target boring B2B) is a genuine strategic angle, but every supporting number is wrong or invented, so the insight is unearned.
evidence.narrative: Slides follow a logical arc: problem (AI saturation) → evidence (category benchmarks) → monetization → distribution → action plan. Structure is coherent even if content is hollow.
evidence.framing: No mention of dataset scope, missingness (274 missing categories, 288 missing audience_type), sample sizes, or limitations. Audience is implied (indie hackers) but never explicitly stated. No methodology slide.
evidence.accuracy: AI median off by ~3x ($177 vs $503). Category names on slide 3 are invented ('Content Workflows', 'General SaaS'). LTD 3.4x multiplier, DR 4.2x multiplier, ARPU table, and exit multiples have no basis in the dataset. At least 7 material factual errors.
evidence.visual: Consistent dark theme, clean layout, good use of big-number callouts. However, slide 3's bar chart uses fabricated categories. No real data visualizations with axes/labels. Repetitive two-card layout across slides 2, 4, 5. Typo on slide 5 ('programmatic programmatic').
evidence.ai_slop: Slide 5 contains a duplicated word ('programmatic programmatic'). Exit multiples and ARPU figures appear to be AI-hallucinated consulting-style numbers with no dataset basis. Slide 6 is generic startup advice template.
